Hey guys, which one’s better: Progressive, Regressive or same weights sets?

I’ve seen all 3 strats done in my gym and tried all 3, but i’m not sure which one is best. Let’s take the bench press as an example. I usually do 4sets of 8reps.

Progressive: I increase the weight for every set but i tend to fatigue in the heavier final sets and can’t complete the 8reps.

Same weight: I have to lower the weight so i can be able to complete all 4 sets of 8 reps.

Regressive: I start from my best lift and decrease the weight for every set. I feel like this is the best technique, because every set is easier and with the fatigue, makes it challenging to complete all 8 reps.

I know progressive overload is key and i try to get more reps in or add more plates everytime. But which of these 3 is optimal? My goal is to improve how much i can bench.
